🧠 Plant — Plant 2 — Bidirectional v1 (ChrimsonR + GtACR2) · RETIRED

RETIRED. GtACR2's reversal potential makes inhibition negligible, so this plant cannot deliver real bidirectional control. Superseded by Plant 3 (ChR2-H134R + eNpHR3.0). Kept only to document earlier distillation runs.

Neurons: 800 excitatory + 200 inhibitory LIF (p=0.1)
